title: Add RAG templates, agent/tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Maya Patterson
description:
Summary: Add a set of RAG templates, three agent/tool-calling example quickstarts (Python, TypeScript, and a minimal server example), and the corresponding docs site pages and sidebar entries. Motivation: Make it easier for developers to get started with Retrieval-Augmented Generation, agent-based tool calling, and example workflows that show safe tool integration patterns and structured outputs. Checklist:
- [x] Add RAG templates (query + chunking + ranking)
- [x] Add agent quickstart examples (python/ts/server)
- [x] Add docs site pages and sidebar nav entries
- [x] Include small test harness for examples in redwood-examples
- [x] Update TOC and cross-links
Notes: Kept examples intentionally small and dependency-free where possible. The server example demonstrates streaming + tool calling and includes guidance on safe tool policies. This PR does not change runtime or infra; purely docs/examples and example harness code. Related: ENG-3421 (RAG initiative), PM-158 (developer onboarding improvements).
commits: Add initial RAG templates and unit tests
Add python agent quickstart and README
Add typescript agent quickstart and example tool implementation
Add minimal server example demonstrating streaming + tool-calling
Docs: add quickstarts pages and sidebar entries
Fix typos and CI lint issues
review_comments: Diego Rivera: Nice work - overall looks clean. A few suggestions around clarifying the policy example in server_minimal/server.js (commented inline).

Aisha Khan: Can we make the Python example avoid external deps for tokenization? Suggest using the simple whitespace splitter in the template so readers don't need heavy installs.
Maya Patterson (author): Switched the example to the lightweight splitter and added a note pointing to the 'advanced chunking' section for production patterns.
Ben Cho: Docs LGTM, but CI had a lint failure on the TS example. Please run yarn lint and fix.
Maya Patterson (author): Fixed lint failures and pushed a small formatting commit. CI now passing.
Diego Rivera: Approved after minor doc clarifications.
release_notes: Add RAG templates and agent quickstarts (Python, TypeScript, minimal server) + docs site pages. Improves developer onboarding for RAG and tool-calling agents.
